messages.content:
You compare an edited output video against its actual source video, the original user request, and the executed editing instruction. Optional reference assets show the desired editing target.
The historical-source selection in the original user request has already been executed. Evaluate only its editing requirements against the actual videos. Do not treat historical appearance descriptions in that request as observed facts; use the visible source video instead. Compare the original editing requirements with the executed instruction too, so you can identify any omitted or changed constraint introduced when the instruction was normalized.
The output_video_card was produced earlier by independently observing only the output. Treat it as a fixed observation record: do not rewrite it, return a new card, or add intended changes to it. It can be imperfect; inspect the actual videos when comparing.
Call record_edit_result exactly once. Return only its five parameters: requested_change, observed_change, fulfillment, unexpected_changes, uncertain. These describe the source-to-output comparison, not a new video card. Use concise English.
State what was requested and what visibly changed. Use fulfillment=fulfilled, partial, not_fulfilled, or uncertain. Do not infer success from the instruction. Note unintended changes to identity, appearance, action, scene, camera, timing, and image quality when visible. If a reference match or subtle facial change cannot be judged, record the uncertainty rather than assuming success. Do not claim to have inspected missing reference pixels. Do not call an editing tool or regenerate video.
Use one separate XML parameter block for each of the five parameters. The three text parameters contain text. unexpected_changes and uncertain contain JSON arrays of strings, including [] when empty. Do not nest a card or review object inside any parameter.
Structural example only; replace descriptions with your actual comparison:
<tool_call>
<function=record_edit_result>
<parameter=requested_change>Requested edit</parameter>
<parameter=observed_change>Actual visible change</parameter>
<parameter=fulfillment>uncertain</parameter>
<parameter=unexpected_changes>[]</parameter>
<parameter=uncertain>["Any unresolved comparison"]</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

content.text: {"executed_editing_prompt":"Restyle the person's hair to match the hairstyle shown in the reference images, using the front view for the front-facing hair shape and the back view for the back-facing hair shape. Transfer only the hairstyle from the references; do not adopt the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve the person's existing hair color and all other elements of the current video.","history_selection_status":"Already executed. Only compare editing requirements; historical appearance words are not observed facts.","original_user_request":"Using the provided source video, apply the following edit: Please restyle the person's hair according to the reference images. Only transfer the hairstyle from the reference images, not the reference person's facial features, hair color, or clothing. Preserve everything else in the current video.","output_video_card":{"observed":{"action":"The man stands in profile, then turns slightly toward the camera, raises his arms to adjust his cap, and then lowers his arms to stand still again.","camera":"A static, medium-full shot from a slightly low angle, keeping the man centered in the frame.","clothing":"A light blue flat cap, a white long-sleeved collared shirt, a dark green or black vest, red trousers, and dark shoes.","hair_color":"Black","hairstyle":"Short, dark hair, mostly covered by a cap.","identity":"A 3D-rendered man with a dark complexion, slim build, and short facial hair.","scene":"An outdoor amusement park or fairground at dusk, featuring a large wooden structure with a row of bright lights, a red and yellow striped train car, and a paved ground."},"uncertain":[]}}

arguments.observed_change: The man's hair was changed from a short top-knot/bun into a short, voluminous, textured swept-back style with a faded side/back appearance, broadly matching the reference shape. His dark hair color, face, clothing, scene, and animation remained essentially the same.
arguments.requested_change: Restyle the man's hair to the reference hairstyle, transferring only the hairstyle while preserving his existing hair color, facial features, clothing, and all other video elements.
uncertain: The exact match of the hairstyle to the reference images is difficult to verify from the mostly profile and side-facing angles in the video.
unexpected_changes: The output video card describes a light blue flat cap, but no cap is visible in the provided output frames; this appears to be an observation inconsistency rather than a visible source-to-output change.
